text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... What is this?
Ever since that last race, my body's felt heavy...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, how clumsy of me...!
I am quite all right. Let us move on to the next menu item.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Alright, keep your elbows in,
and drive your right leg into the punching bag—ah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Just then!
Her heel swung high and slammed directly into the wall."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—Ugyaaaah!?
I blasted another hole right through the wall...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: T-That is strange, is it not...? Normally, it would go with a massive boom...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's a relief she didn't break through the wall,
but it just shows how little strength she had left.
We might want to reconsider her race schedule.
